meta.title: Zotero local reader
meta.description: Open the “Zotero local library” DSH sidebar tab to search by title, author, or abstract, inspect details, and read local PDFs. Uses standard data-directory discovery or set `dataDir` in plugin settings to the folder containing `zotero.sqlite`. Reads local SQLite on demand and refreshes every 15 seconds. Supports PDFs in Zotero storage only; no linked files, PDF full-text search, Web API, or cloud service.
